Maya (AE): Arcadia renewal — they want to rebaseline from 4k -> 9k tokens/day, asking for a 30% uplift discount and EU data residency. Need presales + deal desk input.
Ethan (Solutions Eng): They use chat + occasional long context (1.5k). Recommended dedicated pool + prefix cache. Estimated run-rate list = $14k/mo.
Ivy (CSM): Customer also asks for a 12-month price lock and priority support for the first 90 days.
Sam (Finance): Reminder: floor price constraints. Any effective price below floor needs exec sign-off. Also infra fees (VPC) should be passed through unless approved.
Pri (Deal Desk): Please fill renewal template. Suggest options: A) 25% + customer pays VPC, 12mo; B) 28% + include VPC, 12mo; C) 32% + 24mo prepay.
OpsBot: OpsBot: EU VPC estimated +$1.8k/mo. Capacity check: available in region.
Ethan (Solutions Eng): Quick math: list 14k -> 25% = 10.5k; with VPC passed becomes 12.3k. With 30% discount net ~9.8k, not sustainable with VPC included.
Sam (Finance): Finance prefers Option A or C with prepay. Option B requires VP_Finance sign-off.
Maya (AE): Customer prefers 12mo and wants VPC included. They may prepay 50% if we reach 30%.
Pri (Deal Desk): Escalating for approval: tag @VP_Sales @VP_Finance. If no reply by EOD, we'll offer Option A as fallback.
Ivy (CSM): I'll coordinate support SLA for the 90-day ramp and provide onboarding dates.
Maya (AE): Sending draft proposal to customer now noting contingent VPC timeline and exec approval requirement. Will update when they reply
__notes: renewal uplift discussion: pricing options, VPC infra fee, prepay alternatives, deal-desk escalation
